tldr: OpenAI used its Sep 29 DevDay to announce GPT-6.1 Sol, computer use in the Agents API, cloud-based Codex environments, a Decisions API and new ChatGPT plugin capabilities. Simon Willison live-blogged the keynote from the floor.
whats_new: Latent Space's Sep 30 recap lists the full slate (Dots, 6.1 Sol, Ultrafast, Decisions API, Agents API, Spaces, Marketplace) and cites 1.2 billion ChatGPT weekly users.
why_it_matters: Computer use in the Agents API and hosted Codex environments move more agent execution onto OpenAI's platform, which changes where you run, sandbox and bill agent workloads.

status.detail: DevDay products were announced Sep 29; the coverage here does not give GA dates, pricing or limits.

beats.headline: DevDay 2026: GPT-6.1 Sol, Agents API computer use, cloud Codex, Decisions API
beats.summary: InfoQ's developer recap and Simon Willison's live blog cover the keynote day.

beats.headline: Latent Space tallies the full slate, from Spaces and Marketplace to 1.2B ChatGPT WAU

open_questions: What pricing and rate limits apply to computer use in the Agents API?
When do cloud-based Codex environments and the Decisions API reach general availability?
How does GPT-6.1 Sol perform in independent evals against the prior GPT-6 Astra?
take_for_builders: Do not migrate agent workloads to the new Agents API or hosted Codex yet: run your own evals on GPT-6.1 Sol and wait for published pricing and limits before changing sandboxing or cost budgets.
